name: 通用治理任务
description: 完整的决策与审批双门控流程，适用于各类通用任务。不限制工具类型，由 Soul 按阶段约束能力。
goalText: 完成任务目标并产出结构化交付物。
doDItems: 目标已完成，输出包含明确的执行结果
如发生决策或审批，必须通过后端决策工单（Decision）/审批工单（Approval）记录并可追溯
最终结果通过 DoD 验收评估和 runtime 交付物（Artifact）记录，不要求写入 workspace 报告文件

name: 天气查询治理
description: 通过 MCP 外部天气工具查询指定城市天气，需要决策信息补充和操作审批双门控。
goalText: 查询指定城市当前天气。缺少城市信息时触发决策工单（Decision），工具调用前触发审批工单（Approval）。
doDItems: 缺少目标城市时生成决策工单（Decision）
补充城市信息后生成审批工单（Approval）并等待批准
批准后通过 MCP weather.current 查询指定城市当前天气
运行快照（Run Snapshot）暴露决策工单（Decision）、审批工单（Approval）、工具调用（Tool Call）、校验结果（Validation Result）与 DoD 验收评估证据

name: 软件开发
description: 编码实现、运行测试、修复缺陷的完整软件开发流程。支持项目声明的构建工具、测试框架和原生验证能力。
goalText: 根据需求完成软件开发任务：编码实现、运行测试、修复缺陷、产出交付物。
doDItems: 目标（Goal）对应的需求能力已实现，并与验收范围保持一致
已从 PRD、README、需求文档或用户 Goal 中提取功能目标、约束和验收点，并映射到执行计划
代码和配置变更保持最小且与目标直接相关，并提供 capability-owner receipt 可追溯的 state_change 证据
若 workspace 输出发生有意义变更，必须通过 git/write add/commit 形成本地版本控制快照，并在证据中引用 commit
相关 build/test 验证已执行并通过；无法执行时记录跳过原因和影响评估
若 Goal 或 DoD 涉及 CLI、服务、API、脚本、单二进制或其他运行交付入口，必须提供命中最终交付入口的直接验证证据
针对高风险验收维度的测试必须绑定真实交付入口或生产实现；测试文件中临时定义的 fake/mock/helper 只能作为辅助，不能作为唯一 satisfied 证据
若 Goal 或 DoD 涉及流式、错误透传、配置加载、持久化副作用、并发或其他用户可观察行为，必须提供对应行为的直接验证证据或明确跳过原因与影响
若 Goal 或 DoD 涉及性能、资源占用、压缩率、吞吐、延迟、预算或其他量化指标，必须提供包含实际数值的可执行测量证据，并说明是否达到阈值
每个关键 DoD 条目均有对应的功能测试、集成测试或可解释的替代验证；主路径、错误路径和关键分支均有覆盖说明
lint/静态检查按项目约定执行；缺失命令时记录替代检查或跳过原因
最终结果包含改动摘要、验证命令、验证结果、失败/跳过说明、残余风险和后续建议
DoD 验收评估逐项给出 evidenceRefs，并在交付物索引中可追溯

notes: semantic navigation is optional and must not replace build/test/lint or direct DoD evidence
use semantic capabilities to reduce ambiguity before broad patching when local textual evidence is insufficient
after a relevant patch, sync current file content before relying on semantic diagnostics
semantic outputs can support localization and impact analysis but cannot replace direct validation evidence
Inspect or enumerate available validation targets before selecting a validation route.
Only run discovered targets or controlled substitutes that are explicitly tied to current Goal/DoD coverage.
If no validation target exists, return concrete missing-evidence assessment, deferred evidence, or governance blocker instead of guessing target names.

acceptanceDimensions.description: Goal-level functional behavior and primary path
API, CLI, file format, protocol, input/output compatibility, or other external contract
Command, service, script, package, or callable entrypoint used to run the deliverable
Configuration sources, defaults, environment overrides, and configuration error behavior
File writes, state changes, audit records, or external side effects promised by the Goal or DoD
Error propagation, status, invalid input, dependency failure, or exceptional path behavior
Streaming, incremental output, long-running operation, cancellation, or completion behavior
Concurrent calls, shared state, locks, races, or resource safety
Measured performance, resource use, compression, throughput, latency, budget, or other quantified behavior promised by Goal or DoD
Build artifact, binary, package, document, or other user-facing deliverable

deliverableExpectations.description: Source, configuration, documentation, or workspace state change directly related to Goal
Validation command, test report, lint/static check, or justified skipped validation
Local version-control snapshot for meaningful workspace output changes, including changed paths and commit evidence

guidance: Run validation from an isolated scratch directory or managed validation session when the check needs temporary files, generated harnesses, ports, or subprocess cleanup.
Prefer validation/managed_session for service, proxy, streaming, long-running, temporary-port, or cleanup-sensitive checks when that capability is available.
Use bounded foreground commands or project test harnesses when managed validation is unavailable; do not use detached background processes as validation evidence.

evidenceRequirements.description: Entrypoint claims must be supported by direct executable validation or equivalent action evidence, not only by read-only inspection or summary artifacts; service lifecycle validation should prefer runtime-managed validation session when available.
Read-only file evidence can show existing state, but cannot prove writes, append behavior, audit records, or other side effects.
Streaming or long-running behavior must be supported by executed validation or equivalent runtime action evidence; prefer runtime-managed validation session when available.
API, CLI, protocol, format, or other external contract claims must be supported by direct validation or equivalent action evidence.
Error-path behavior must be supported by executed validation or equivalent runtime action evidence.
Concurrency claims must be supported by executed validation or equivalent runtime action evidence.
Quantified performance, resource, compression, throughput, latency, or budget claims must cite executed measurement evidence with actual numeric output and threshold comparison.
Software-development acceptance dimensions that admit managed validation require an explicit, profile-owned path for preparing and re-observing their exact owner-native assertion.

A satisfied source_change deliverable must cite direct state-changing File write or patch evidence for the workspace output with coverageTargets aligned to the Goal, DoD, or deliverable item, not only read-only inspection or summary artifacts.
A validation_report must cite bounded executed validation evidence. Any accepted source_change evidence declared after this report reopens the report through the sealed coverage dependency.
A satisfied version-control snapshot must cite git/write evidence, normally add plus commit, rather than read-only inspection or shell-based git commands.

Satisfied DoD items must be backed by direct evidence whose output, input, or coverageTargets align with the specific claim; a generic build/test pass is not sufficient for detailed behavioral claims.

Satisfied Goal coverage items must be backed by direct evidence whose output, input, or coverageTargets align with the specific Goal requirement; broad validation commands cannot close unrelated Goal leaves by themselves.

evidencePolicies.evidenceReason: test command completed without executing matching tests

coverageRequirements.description: DoD satisfaction claims require direct validation evidence; zero-work validation is inconclusive.
Goal coverage claims require direct validation evidence; zero-work validation is inconclusive.

evidencePolicies.description: Validation evidence must represent actual executed work before it can support a satisfied DoD item.

name: 代码审查
description: 对代码进行只读分析，检查代码质量、安全隐患和最佳实践。发现问题时触发决策。
goalText: 审查指定代码，检查代码质量、安全隐患、性能问题和最佳实践符合性。
doDItems: 代码质量问题已识别并记录
安全隐患已检查
性能热点已标注
最佳实践偏差已指出
审查报告已生成

name: 文档生成
description: 从代码和上下文生成结构化文档——API 文档、README、架构说明。
goalText: 根据提供的代码和上下文生成完整的技术文档。
doDItems: 文档覆盖所有公开接口和模块
示例代码可运行
格式符合规范（Markdown/OpenAPI）
文档结构完整（概述、安装、使用、API 参考）
交付物以文档类型 Artifact 产出

name: 数据分析
description: 执行数据分析任务——查询数据库、运行 Python/R 脚本、生成分析报告。优先级低于其他任务（priority=1）。
goalText: 根据需求完成数据分析：获取数据、清洗处理、统计建模、生成分析报告。
doDItems: 数据已成功获取
数据清洗和处理已完成
分析结果可视化或统计输出已生成
分析报告包含方法、结果和结论
中间数据和脚本可复现
